blocks.html: PHP is great for building web pages, and MySQL is great for storing data. This chapter is about connecting the two — making PHP talk to MySQL. This combination powers about 70% of all websites! The MySQLi functions and their syntax are asked in Part I, III, and IV questions.

blocks.def: An extension in PHP scripting language that gives access to the MySQL database. MySQLi = MySQL Improved. Introduced in PHP version 5.0.0.
1. mysqli_connect() — establishes connection. 2. mysqli_query() — executes SQL queries. 3. mysqli_close() — closes connection.
Used to connect to the MySQL database server from PHP. Requires FOUR parameters: Server Name, User Name, Password, and Database Name.
$conn = mysqli_connect($servername, $username, $password, $DB_name); if (!$conn) { die("Connection failed: " . mysqli_connect_error()); } echo "Connected successfully";

blocks.label: ⭐ Exam Tip
blocks.text: mysqli_connect() takes FOUR parameters: Server Name, User Name, Password, DB Name. This is asked every year in MCQ. Also: MySQLi was introduced in PHP version 5.0.0.

blocks.def: Used to execute SQL query statements in PHP. Requires TWO parameters: Connection Object and SQL Query string.
$con = mysqli_connect("localhost", "my_user", "my_password", "Student_DB"); $sql = "SELECT student_name, student_age FROM student"; mysqli_query($con, $sql);
Closes an existing open database connection between PHP and MySQL server. Requires ONE parameter: the Connection Object.

blocks.label: ⭐ Exam Tip
blocks.text: Parameter count for MySQLi functions — MCQ favourite: mysqli_connect() = 4 parameters. mysqli_query() = 2 parameters. mysqli_close() = 1 parameter.

Approximately 544 million websites used PHP stack as of January 2018. The PHP and MySQL combination has become the most popular server-side web scripting language on the Internet.
PHP has attracted many software frameworks: PRADO, CakePHP, Symfony, CodeIgniter, Laravel, Yii, Phalcon, Zend Framework.
Facebook was originally built in PHP. Facebook created its own compiler (HipHop HPHP'c) to convert PHP code into C++ for better performance.

blocks.label: ⭐ Master Checklist
blocks.text: MySQLi = MySQL Improved extension in PHP (version 5.0.0+). 3 functions: mysqli_connect (4 params), mysqli_query (2 params), mysqli_close (1 param). 4 connection variables: servername, username, password, DB_name. Steps: connect → query → fetch rows → close. PHP is open source, server-side, supports MySQL, embeds in HTML.
